name: Aravind Brakash
original_name: アラヴィンド・ブラカーシ
source: Cathedral's main doctor who has been working there ever since it was established. He is in charge of maintaining the health of its personnel. On top of being impotent, he is rather apathetic towards people and tends to remember the girls by their ID numbers instead of names.
